recognize_zh: 視野中聚集許多漿細胞：核偏於一側、染色質粗塊狀、細胞質豐富呈灰藍色並有核旁淡染區（hof）；右下一顆大型細胞含三個核，屬多核漿細胞。影像對焦不佳，細節有限。
features: Cluster of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm
Coarse clumped chromatin; perinuclear hof visible in several cells
Large multinucleated (trinucleate) plasma cell at lower right
Variation in plasma cell size with some immature-appearing forms
Occasional neutrophil and a clear vacuole/fat space; image is out of focus with color cast, limiting assessment of nucleoli
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin, perinuclear hofs and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm. Plasma cells vary in size, and a large trinucleate plasma cell is present. A neutrophil is seen at the edge of the cluster. Suboptimal focus and color balance limit evaluation of nucleoli and cytoplasmic inclusions. Sheets of plasma cells with multinucleated forms are suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm; the plasma cell percentage and clonality (κ/λ restriction, serum/urine M-protein) are needed for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are usually mature, scattered or perivascular and polytypic, and rarely form sheets with multinucleated forms.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell population.
Plasmablasts are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli, unlike these mostly mature-appearing plasma cells.
